messages:
Asha R: Heads up — noticed cohort timeline sparks jump when switching compare mode to 'relative' after quantized run. Timeline bars misalign with drilldown counts. Repro on latest prod scorecard.

Jon P: hmm, can you paste a short repro? which model/version?

Asha R: model: redwood/v1-quant8, baseline: redwood/v1-fp16. Steps:
1) open scorecard -> select cohort 'search-intent'
2) toggle Compare: Relative
3) hover over sparkline -> counts show older bucket

Asha R: here's query we used in runner:
```
SELECT cohort, time_bucket('1h', ts) AS t, count(*) as cnt
FROM eval_runs
WHERE model = 'redwood/v1-quant8'
GROUP BY cohort, t
ORDER BY t
LIMIT 500
```

Kai: I saw something similar on a canary. Might be the normalize-to-baseline path rewriting timestamps when we compute percent-change. Could be a windowing bug.

Eva L: Logging from the UI when toggle occurs shows `len(buckets)!=len(sparkline_points)` and a traceback to diff-aggregator -> time-aligner.

infra-bot: Deploy 2026-03-18T10:12Z: rolled out diff-aggregator v2.4.9 to prod

Jon P: ok can someone run `runner-ci` job `eval-dashboard/integration` with `--focus timeline` ? CI sometimes catches the bucket misalign.

ci-runner-bot: Job started: eval-dashboard/integration#987 (focus=timeline). Link: http://ci.local/runs/987

Asha R: Thx — attaching a short screenshot and sample export id 223c-sample-42 (sent in thread)

Maya: Quick workaround: toggle to absolute mode then back to relative — UI re-syncs. We'll add a short ephemeral fix to force re-aggregate on compare-mode change. I'll add to eng-ml board.

Jon P: I'll take a look at the time-aligner code. If it's the baseline normalization step, might be a one-line fix but need tests. Can someone assign to me?

Eva L: Assigned to Jon P. Adding a unit test case with mismatched bucket counts and ensure `align_buckets()` returns same length arrays.

Asha R: thanks all. please ping here when CI green or when patch merged :thumbsup:
